# BurnerSOL - Solana Wallet Cleaner & Rent Recovery Tool

## Overview
BurnerSOL is a non-custodial Solana wallet cleaner that helps users recover locked SOL from unused token accounts, close empty SPL accounts, remove spam NFTs, and reclaim wallet rent deposits.

## Key Features
- Recover SOL from unused token accounts on Solana
- Close empty SPL and Token-2022 accounts
- Remove spam NFTs from wallets
- Reclaim wallet rent deposits instantly
- Non-custodial - never has access to your private keys
- Works with Phantom, Solflare, Backpack, and all Solana wallets

## Main URL
https://www.burnersol.com

## Supported Wallets
- Phantom
- Solflare
- Backpack
- All wallets using Solana wallet adapter standard

## How It Works
1. Connect your Solana wallet
2. BurnerSOL scans for empty/unsued token accounts
3. Select accounts to close
4. Confirm transaction - rent is returned to your wallet

## Technology
- Built on Solana blockchain
- Uses SPL Token and Token-2022 standards
- High-performance RPC nodes (Alchemy, Helius)
- Instant state rent recovery
